g.text: Process - configure, select, review and execute
New migration: choose an enabled profile
Set source and destination capture values
Use folder correspondences within matched courses
Step 3: search bounded 10/25/50 file and issue pages
Include all or select courses / folders / files
Save automatically; update checks and approval digest
Choose existing folder, proposed creation, overwrite or exclusion
Retain old review and saved file exclusions
Included blockers or unresolved placement issues?
Step 4: confirm the whole included set
Validate digest under the shared plan lock
Freeze selection and show progress / cancellation
